programme.title: Sonic X
programme.desc: While trying to retrieve the 7th Chaos Emerald from Dr. Eggman, Sonic and Friends are transported to the human world where Sonic is rescued by a boy named Chris.

programme.title: Sonic X
programme.desc: Sonic discovers that Cream and Cheese are being held captive by the military. Sonic, with the help of Chris and his grandfather Chuck, finds and frees them only to be caught in a trap!

programme.title: Sonic X
programme.desc: When Eggman tries to use E-23 to take over the world Amy, Knuckles and Tails launch an unsuccessful counterattack, until Sonic arrives! And with a ring from Tails, Sonic destroys E-23 and saves Amy with the help of Knuckles.

programme.title: Sonic X
programme.desc: Chris' teacher has been replaced with the President's spy, Mr. Stewart. Meanwhile, the first Chaos Emerald appears at a construction site. It's then a race to the stone between Eggman and Sonic!

programme.title: Sonic X
programme.desc: After Eggman tricks Knuckles into blaming Sonic for being stuck in the human world, Knuckles challenges Sonic to a duel! But Knuckles realizes he's being duped and teams up with Sonic to destroy the robot and save the others.

programme.title: LUPIN THE 3rd PART 2 [English Subtitle]
programme.sub-title: LUPIN THE 3rd PART 2 -EP80 The Last Gift in Prison is Cup Ramen [English Subtitle]
programme.desc: Silver, who once worked with Lupin on a train robbery, stole the money himself, hid it somewhere, and promptly got himself thrown into prison on a rinky-dink charge. Lupin, having learned that Silver is about to be released, goes to the prison intent on making Silver tell what he did with the loot, only to discover that, while Silver was in prison, a new top-of-the-line prison was built over the site where he hid the money. Now, will the operation to trade an execution for the recovery of the money succeed?!

programme.title: LUPIN THE 3rd PART 2 [English Subtitle]
programme.sub-title: LUPIN THE 3rd PART 2 -EP81 Fujiko, Men are A Sorry Lot! [English Subtitle]
programme.desc: Lupin is after the Golden Bell, symbol of the monarchy of Beltenberg and precious tourist attraction. However, the bell that sparkles in the belfry is just a brass replica. Though Fujiko insists that the bell made of gold doesn't exist, Lupin believes to the contrary. Meanwhile, Lupin gets news of Fujiko's engagement to prince Claude of Beltenberg, whom she had met in Paris.

programme.title: LUPIN THE 3rd PART 2 [English Subtitle]
programme.sub-title: LUPIN THE 3rd PART 2 -EP82 Hostage Rescue Operation: Pops [English Subtitle]
programme.desc: Zenigata is taken hostage from ICPO headquarters. The terrorists demand to swap him with their boss Napoleon XI, but ICPO refuses. Since Zenigata is no further use to them, the terrorists are bound to kill him; Lupin must now come to his rescue but do it delicately so as to not hurt Zenigata's pride. Thus, begins Lupin's Zenigata-rescue caper ...

programme.title: LUPIN THE 3rd PART 2 [English Subtitle]
programme.sub-title: LUPIN THE 3rd PART 2 -EP83 Lupin’s Big Western [English Subtitle]
programme.desc: The Smith Gang hit-man company was once the best in the business, but they're suffering now from tough competition. Though the company chairman Smith considers running TV ads to revive his business, he can't think of a good way to do it. Fujiko gets word that he's willing to shovel out 300 million dollars for a good idea, so they decide to film a Western in which Lupin gets killed ...

programme.title: LUPIN THE 3rd PART 2 [English Subtitle]
programme.sub-title: LUPIN THE 3rd PART 2 -EP84 Leave the Revenge to Lupin [English Subtitle]
programme.desc: Though Joe Spade was once a formidable hitman of renown and Jigen's sharpshooter coach, he now comes to beg for Jigen's help; he had gotten old, flubbed a hit contract, and is now on the run. Jigen decides to help his old mentor and heads to Mareseilles with Lupin, but Lupin has a change of heart because he hates killers. So Jigen heads to Jigen's ramshakle shack all by himself ...

programme.title: Kabaneri of the Iron Fortress [English Subtitle]
programme.sub-title: Kabaneri of the Iron Fortress E01 [English Subtitle]
programme.desc: At a time when the industrial revolution was carrying the world into the modern age, a horde of undead monsters suddenly appeared. They could not be killed unless their hearts, which were protected by a layer of iron, were pierced. Humans bitten by them would come back as undead monsters themselves. These undead, which would later be known as "Kabane," exploded in population until they finally overran the world. - - The people of Hinomoto, a nation in the far east, built fortresses known as "stations" throughout the land that have allowed them to survive the threat of the Kabane. People can only travel between these stations using fortified steam locomotives known as "Hayajiro," and they have managed to stay alive by sharing resources in this way. - - Ikoma is a young steamsmith living at Aragane Station, a city that specializes in the manufacture of iron and steam engines. He is working on developing a unique anti-Kabane weapon called a "piercing gun" as he waits for his chance to prove his strength. - - Then, one day, a Hayajiro called the "Iron Fortress" makes its way through the front lines to arrive at Aragane Station. When Ikoma begins his usual maintenance routine, he sees a mysterious girl who is exempt from her Kabane inspection. That night, Ikoma sees the girl again and learns that her name is Mumei, but then an out-of-control Hayajiro overrun by Kabane charges into Aragane Station. - - The Kabane pour out of the train into Aragane Station. Ikoma races against the flow of the panicked residents, this time determined not to run away, but to defeat the Kabane with his piercing gun!

programme.title: Magic Kaito 1412 [English Dub]
programme.sub-title: Magic Kaito 1412 EP03 Hustler vs. Magician [English Dub]
programme.desc: Kaito goes up against a Syndicate-owned pool hall hustler to win back the Legendary Cue, a treasure once owned by Jii before he was cheated it out of it by the Syndicate boss many years ago. However, things look dire when Jii's pool hall is put on the line and Kaito apparently has no skill with the game.

programme.title: Beelzebub [English Subtitle]
programme.desc: Oga and Furuichi head off to school to start the new term... except Ishiyama High is still completely destroyed thanks to a certain someone. So instead, all the students from Ishiyama are split up and sent off to different high schools temporarily. Furuichi is all excited since they're heading to St. Ishiyama Academy, the most prestigious school in the area, but when they get there the reality of exactly how they are treated becomes apparent...

programme.title: Beelzebub [English Subtitle]
programme.desc: Oga gains his own follower in Kazuya, who will do anything to become strong like Oga. Oga, increasingly annoyed at Kazuya tailing him everywhere, finally decides to train him. Meanwhile, Aoi is jealous of how easily Azusa, Kazuya's childhood friend, can act cute and girly in front of a guy, and invites her for a little chat to the shrine where she lives.

programme.title: Beelzebub [English Subtitle]
programme.desc: Angelica is visiting the Human World for her birthday, and Furuichi is all excited for his big sleepover! But Angelica brought an unexpected gift with her from the Demon World... Yes, they're back! It's a Yople Alien! Knowing the grave danger this poses the city, nay, the world, Angelica does the only thing you can do in this situation: Recruit a 5 member squad of pseudo magical girls and partner with a muscled Moyashi-man to defeat the Blue Ears and save the day!

programme.title: Magic Kaito 1412 [English Dub]
programme.sub-title: Magic Kaito 1412 EP01 The Revived Phantom Thief Kid [English Dub]
programme.desc: It seems the notorious Kid the Phantom Thief has returned after eight years. Kaito puts on his dad's old cape, hat, and monocle and takes to the air to get answers.

programme.title: Sonic X
programme.desc: Eggman tries to use his robot "Intellihente" to brainwash Chris' class but when it winds up teaching more than brainwashing, Eggman steps in to put the children in permanent detention until a worried Sonic arrives, destroys the robot and saves the class.

programme.title: Sonic X
programme.desc: When Mr. Stewart drops by for a surprise visit, Chris and Chuck are barely able to keep Sonic and Friends' stay a secret and after Chris' uncle arrives, things get messier. Everyone, including Ella and Mr. Tanaka, are going to find out!

programme.title: Sonic X
programme.desc: After Eggman discovers that he is being watched by the military he sends E-90 to swallow the satellite, but this disrupts everyone's TVs! So, Chuck and Tails decide to upgrade the Tornado into X-Tornado, allowing Sonic to enter high altitude in order to destroy E-90.

programme.title: Sonic X
programme.desc: After Chris, Amy, Cream and Cheese arrive at a resort, Eggman appears and tries to take over with his E-39 but Sonic arrives and tries to stop him. However Sonic is unable to swim, and the robot tries to drag him into the ocean!

programme.title: Sonic X
programme.desc: It's Team Sonic vs Team Eggman in a game of baseball for a Chaos Emerald! Team Sonic falls behind at first but then wins with a Sonic super-play, only to have Eggman to cheat and try to steal the Emerald regardless!

programme.title: LUPIN THE 3rd PART 2 [English Subtitle]
programme.sub-title: LUPIN THE 3rd PART 2 -EP85 The ICPO’s Secret Order [English Subtitle]
programme.desc: ICPO Bureau Chief Jasmine is an able commissioner. She uses the governor to spur Zenigata into action, as she has a secret plan to arrest Lupin. But Jasmine's plan is to make this mission her very last at ICPO so she could get married. Who is Jasmine marrying? Will her plan to arrest Lupin succeed?

programme.title: LUPIN THE 3rd PART 2 [English Subtitle]
programme.sub-title: LUPIN THE 3rd PART 2 -EP86 The Mysterious Nocturnal Mask [English Subtitle]
programme.desc: Nocturnal Mask murdered the Duke of Le Mond and stole his diamonds. ICPO is having trouble solving the case, so they induct mystery author Conan Drill as a special inspector. Drill deduces that the true identity of Nocturnal Mask is Lupin. Learning that Count Johannes is his next target, he and Zenigata lie in wait at the Johannes Mansion, where a costume ball is taking place ...

programme.title: LUPIN THE 3rd PART 2 [English Subtitle]
programme.sub-title: LUPIN THE 3rd PART 2 -EP87 When the Devil Calls to Lupin [English Subtitle]
programme.desc: In a night of thunder and rain, a man gives Lupin a doll. That very night Lupin has a nightmare of being manipulated by a man named Mephistopheles. The next day there is a news report that a diamond called the Phoenix Tear had been stolen. Though Lupin had been caught on security camera, he has no recollection of having done the deed. What is going on?

programme.title: LUPIN THE 3rd PART 2 [English Subtitle]
programme.sub-title: LUPIN THE 3rd PART 2 -EP88 Lupin's North Pole, South Pole Adventure [English Subtitle]
programme.desc: Lupin's target is the Vatican Crown, located at the North Pole. He devises a plan to thwart pesky Fujiko, which is to relocate penguins at the South Pole to the North Pole; Lupin takes a flight to the South Pole to gather penguins, then heads to the North Pole. But Fujiko learns of his antics and with the help of an underground organization called the Red Voyagers League, heads to the North Pole. Who will claim the prize of the Vatican Crown?

programme.title: LUPIN THE 3rd PART 2 [English Subtitle]
programme.sub-title: LUPIN THE 3rd PART 2 -EP89 Play the Thief's Symphony [English Subtitle]
programme.desc: The Worldwide Crime Prevention Association has developed the "killer safe" that sent many safe crackers to their graves. Their ultimate product is the atomic safe, located 100 meters underground, which is said to detect sounds and detonate, blowing thieves to smithereens. Not only that, the bomb goes off when the weight of the elevator going up is heavier than when it went down. But Lupin takes the challenge to steal what it guards, regardless. The end result is ...

programme.title: Kabaneri of the Iron Fortress [English Subtitle]
programme.sub-title: Kabaneri of the Iron Fortress E04 [English Subtitle]
programme.desc: At a time when the industrial revolution was carrying the world into the modern age, a horde of undead monsters suddenly appeared. They could not be killed unless their hearts, which were protected by a layer of iron, were pierced. Humans bitten by them would come back as undead monsters themselves. These undead, which would later be known as "Kabane," exploded in population until they finally overran the world. - - The people of Hinomoto, a nation in the far east, built fortresses known as "stations" throughout the land that have allowed them to survive the threat of the Kabane. People can only travel between these stations using fortified steam locomotives known as "Hayajiro," and they have managed to stay alive by sharing resources in this way. - - Ikoma is a young steamsmith living at Aragane Station, a city that specializes in the manufacture of iron and steam engines. He is working on developing a unique anti-Kabane weapon called a "piercing gun" as he waits for his chance to prove his strength. - - Then, one day, a Hayajiro called the "Iron Fortress" makes its way through the front lines to arrive at Aragane Station. When Ikoma begins his usual maintenance routine, he sees a mysterious girl who is exempt from her Kabane inspection. That night, Ikoma sees the girl again and learns that her name is Mumei, but then an out-of-control Hayajiro overrun by Kabane charges into Aragane Station. - - The Kabane pour out of the train into Aragane Station. Ikoma races against the flow of the panicked residents, this time determined not to run away, but to defeat the Kabane with his piercing gun!

programme.sub-title: Magic Kaito 1412 EP04 A Great Detective Comes to Light [English Dub]
programme.desc: A brilliant if arrogant teen detective comes to town, determined to capture Kid the Phantom Thief. This turns the heat up for Kaito, especially since they're classmates. In fact, Kaito becomes Suguru's rival even out of uniform, leading to a "gentlemen's bet" over which of them will go on a date with Aoko.

programme.title: Magic Kaito 1412 [English Dub]
programme.sub-title: Magic Kaito 1412 EP05 Scarlet Seduction [English Dub]
programme.desc: Kaito has a new classmate, Akako, who appears to possess genuine magic abilities, the kind that bend everyone to her will... except for Kaito and his alter ego, Kid the Phantom Thief! Who will come out on top in the inevitable showdown, sorceress or illusionist?

programme.title: Pluto TV Anime
programme.desc: no info available

programme.title: JoJo's Bizarre Adventure: Silver Chariot
programme.desc: Jotaro and his comrades are attacked by Polnareff, an assassin with a Stand called "Silver Chariot" that is capable of lightning-fast swordplay. It falls to Avdol to face down the threat using "Magician's Red."

programme.title: JoJo's Bizarre Adventure: Strength
programme.desc: Jotaro’s group is rescued when they spot a giant cargo ship, but they soon find that the only occupant is a strange orangutan. Curious, they begin to explore the ship and solve its mysteries.

programme.title: JoJo's Bizarre Adventure: Dark Blue Moon
programme.desc: Jotaro welcomes a new member to the team and the group leaves for Singapore by ship. Along the way, a young stowaway is found and Jotaro comes under attack, but is the child the source of this latest evil?

programme.title: JoJo's Bizarre Adventure
programme.desc: Jotaro and his companions finally make it to a hotel in Singapore, but soon Polnareff falls into a trap set by a dangerous and brutal enemy.

programme.title: JoJo's Bizarre Adventure: Yellow Temperance
programme.desc: Joseph uses his Stand to generate a spirit message from a TV, only to receive a warning claiming that Kakyoin is a traitor. Meanwhile, Jotaro, Ann and Kakyoin are out exploring Singapore when Kakyoin begins acting strangely.

programme.title: JoJo's Bizarre Adventure
programme.desc: The Joestars' group arrives in India, where Polnareff is attacked by a Stand only visible through a mirror. As terrifying as it is, the Stand could also be related to his sister's murder.

programme.title: JoJo's Bizarre Adventure: The Emperor and the Hanged Man Part 2
programme.sub-title: The Emperor and the Hanged Man Part 2
programme.desc: When Avdol is struck down defending Polnareff, the Frenchman goes into a state of shock, leaving him vulnerable. That is when "Hanged Man," Centerfold's Stand, begins its most furious attack.

programme.title: JoJo's Bizarre Adventure: The Empress
programme.desc: Jotaro and the others next head toward Varanasi. On their way there, Joseph realizes his arm is quite swollen. At first, it doesn't bother him much, but the bigger it gets, the creepier it looks.

programme.title: JoJo's Bizarre Adventure: Justice Part 1
programme.desc: After surviving another attack, Jotaro and his team make it to Pakistan, where they stop at an inn to rest. The village around the inn, however, is quiet, and its inhabitants rather odd.

programme.title: JoJo's Bizarre Adventure: Wheel of Fortune
programme.desc: Jotaro and his group head toward Pakistan by car. Polnareff is behind the wheel on a dangerous mountain road when a mysterious vehicle starts impeding their progress.

programme.title: JoJo's Bizarre Adventure: Justice Part 2
programme.desc: Polnareff realizes that Enyaba is a new assassin sent by DIO. He is prevented from warning his comrades by Enyaba's Stand "Justice," which has the ability to control corpses.

programme.title: JoJo's Bizarre Adventure: The Lovers Part 1
programme.desc: After surviving Enyaba's attack, Jotaro and crew make it to Pakistan's capital, Karachi. There, they encounter DIO's next assassin, Dan of Steel.

programme.title: JoJo's Bizarre Adventure: The Lovers Part 2
programme.desc: Dan of Steel's Stand, "The Lovers," has entered Joseph's brain. With Joseph's life on the line, Jotaro has no choice but to carry out Dan's orders, but the rest of his companions have their own say in the matter.

programme.title: JoJo's Bizarre Adventure: The Sun
programme.desc: Jotaro and his fellows take camels and travel across the desert, headed for Cairo. Along the way, though, they can't shake the sensation that someone or something is watching their every move.

programme.title: JoJo's Bizarre Adventure: Death 13, Part 2
programme.desc: Kakyoin tries to convince the others that the baby is a Stand user, but they merely start to doubt his sanity. Unable to persuade his friends, Kakyoin resorts to some extreme measures.

programme.title: JoJo's Bizarre Adventure: Death 13, Part 1
programme.desc: Kakyoin dreams about being in a strange amusement park, where he encounters the Death tarot card. While in the dream he witnesses Death cut down a dog, but after waking up in terror he can't remember what the nightmare was about.

programme.title: JoJo's Bizarre Adventure: Judgment, Part 2
programme.desc: Polnareff revives his sister Shelly using one of his three wishes but is then attacked by her. The enemy Stand user, Cameo, then says he'll grant Polnareff's last wish and revives Avdol.

programme.title: JoJo's Bizarre Adventure: Judgment, Part 1
programme.desc: Jotaro and the team visit an island in the Red Sea and find Avdol's father, renewing the grief Polnareff felt over his friend's death. But perhaps there is a way he can right that wrong. Or not.

programme.title: JoJo's Bizarre Adventure: The High Priestess, Part 1
programme.desc: Jotaro and the others obtain a submarine as a new means of transport, but as they travel through the Red Sea they realize that there are few places to escape to should danger arise underwater.

programme.title: JoJo's Bizarre Adventure: The High Priestess, Part 2
programme.desc: The team attempts to escape the submarine with scuba gear as it sinks under attacks from the shape-changing enemy Stand "High Priestess."

programme.title: JoJo's Bizarre Adventure: Iggy the Fool and Geb's N'doul, Part 1
programme.sub-title: Iggy the Fool and Geb's N'doul, Part 1
programme.desc: Jotaro and his friends finally land in Egypt, where DIO awaits, and are cutting through the desert when a helicopter approaches. The helicopter belongs to the Speedwagon Foundation and is there to make a special delivery requested by Joseph.

programme.title: JoJo's Bizarre Adventure: Iggy the Fool and Geb's N'doul, Part 2
programme.sub-title: Iggy the Fool and Geb's N'doul, Part 2
programme.desc: Jotaro and crew acquire the help of Iggy but are ambushed by a water Stand. With Kakyoin injured, Avdol tries out a stratagem which the unseen enemy quickly sees through. Meanwhile, Iggy is napping.

programme.title: JoJo's Bizarre Adventure: Khnum's Zenyatta and Thoth's Mondatta
programme.desc: After the battle with N'doul, Kakyoin and Avdol are badly hurt, so the group heads for a hospital in Aswan. Unfortunately, dangerous enemies could be all around them even there.

programme.title: JoJo's Bizarre Adventure: Anubis, Part 1
programme.desc: A young man named Chaka finds a mysterious sword on the beach. Though other men try, Chaka is the only one who can draw it. The sword claims Chaka as its master and sends the youth in pursuit of Jotaro and his friends with deadly intent.

programme.title: JoJo's Bizarre Adventure: Anubis, Part 2
programme.desc: Having defeated the "Anubis" Stand user Chaka, Polnareff pays a visit to a barber. But when the barber starts attacking him with Chaka's sword, the Frenchman realizes the sword itself is the Stand user.

programme.title: JoJo's Bizarre Adventure: Bast's Mariah, Part 1
programme.desc: On the way to Luxor, Joseph notices an electrical outlet set in a rock. Fascinated by the rare sight, Joseph goes in for a closer look and gets shocked. Though he seems fine afterward, soon all manner of small accidents begin to occur around him.

programme.title: JoJo's Bizarre Adventure: Bast's Mariah, Part 2
programme.desc: Due to the powers of an enemy Stand, Joseph's body becomes magnetized. While chasing after the woman he suspects is the Stand user, Joseph learns that Avdol has also become magnetized from touching a different electrical outlet.

programme.title: JoJo's Bizarre Adventure: Set's Alessi, Part 1
programme.desc: With Joseph and Avdol busy fighting Mariah, Jotaro and Polnareff get concerned about why they haven't shown up yet. As the two search Luxor, Polnareff senses someone following them and confronts the man.

programme.title: JoJo's Bizarre Adventure: Set's Alessi, Part 2
programme.desc: The power of Alessi's Stand "Set" has turned Polnareff back into a child, leaving him confused and alone. A passerby named Marena takes the boy into her home to help him, but they are followed by Alessi and his terrible powers.

programme.title: JoJo's Bizarre Adventure: D'Arby the Gambler, Part 1
programme.desc: After a long journey, Jotaro and his friends finally reach Cairo. They begin asking about the location of DIO's palace and find one man who says he has information, but will only answer if the group can beat him in a game.

programme.title: JoJo's Bizarre Adventure: D'Arby the Gambler, Part 2
programme.desc: After losing to D'Arby, Joseph and Polnareff have their souls taken. In order to have their souls returned, Jotaro shows off Star Platinum's powers before beginning a match with D'Arby, warning him that cheating won't work.

programme.title: JoJo's Bizarre Adventure: Hol Horse and Mondatta, Part 1
programme.desc: Hol Horse arrives at Cairo in order to pursue Jotaro and the others. He has joined forces with another partner and is after the lives of Jotaro and crew once more. What's more, his new partner is none other than Mondatta.

programme.title: JoJo's Bizarre Adventure: Hol Horse and Mondatta, Part 2
programme.desc: Following Mondatta's prediction, Hol Horse sticks his fingers into Polnareff's nose, but he doesn't know what to do from there. Making matters worse, Jotaro and the others show up in search of Polnareff, forcing Hol Horse into a tough spot.

programme.title: JoJo's Bizarre Adventure: The Guardian of Hell, Pet Shop, Part 1
programme.sub-title: The Guardian of Hell, Pet Shop, Part 1
programme.desc: Jotaro and his friends continue to search for DIO's mansion in Cairo. Following Avdol's advice, they have a beggar look for the mansion and wait. Meanwhile, Iggy, wandering the city alone, is confronted by two large dogs.

programme.title: JoJo's Bizarre Adventure: The Guardian of Hell, Pet Shop, Part 2
programme.sub-title: The Guardian of Hell, Pet Shop, Part 2
programme.desc: Iggy ends up in a battle to the death in the sewers against Pet Shop, the falcon that guards DIO's mansion. Despite being injured, Iggy runs to the river in an attempt to escape, but he may have underestimated Pet Shop's abilities.

programme.title: JoJo's Bizarre Adventure: D'Arby the Player, Part 1
programme.desc: Though purchased dearly with Iggy's injury, Jotaro and his group finally have the location of DIO's palace. Waiting for them where they find the butler, Darby Younger, brother of the gambler they previously defeated.

programme.title: JoJo's Bizarre Adventure: D'Arby the Player, Part 2
programme.desc: The battle for souls with D'Arby continues. Kakyoin challenges D'Arby to a racing game but ends up losing both the race and his soul. Before Joseph really has time to react, Jotaro picks the next game.

programme.title: JoJo's Bizarre Adventure: The Miasma of the Void, Cool Ice, Part 1
programme.sub-title: The Miasma of the Void, Cool Ice, Part 1
programme.desc: The baseball game with D'Arby continues within DIO's mansion. For some reason, Jotaro starts telling D'Arby what pitches he'll be throwing. D'Arby finds Jotaro's actions strange, but still believes he has the upper hand because of his Stand's abilities.

programme.title: JoJo's Bizarre Adventure: The Miasma of the Void, Cool Ice, Part 3
programme.sub-title: The Miasma of the Void, Cool Ice, Part 3
programme.desc: Polnareff is pushed to his limits by Cool Ice's merciless attacks. As he awaits death, the dying Iggy manages to save him at the last minute. Polnareff then stabs Cool Ice in the head. Despite showing resilience to the attacks so far.

programme.title: JoJo's Bizarre Adventure: The Miasma of the Void, Cool Ice, Part 2
programme.sub-title: The Miasma of the Void, Cool Ice, Part 2
programme.desc: After a long, hard journey, the group is suddenly faced with saying goodbye to a friend. Polnareff can't control his emotions and starts brandishing his sword toward an unseen enemy with very little success.

programme.title: JoJo's Bizarre Adventure: DIO's World, Part 1
programme.desc: Polnareff finally comes face-to-face with DIO. Despite Polnareff's hostility, DIO offers to forgive him and allow the Frenchman to join his side again. Polnareff refuses, but for some reason, he cannot get any closer to DIO.

programme.title: JoJo's Bizarre Adventure: DIO's World, Part 2

programme.title: JoJo's Bizarre Adventure: DIO's World, Part 3
programme.desc: Thanks to Kakyoin, Joseph is able to figure out that DIO's Stand, "The World," has the power to stop time, but is quickly defeated by DIO. Jotaro then attacks The World with Star Platinum but is no match for DIO's power.

programme.title: Jingdezhen Handmade Porcelain
programme.desc: Porcelain has shaped the culture of the whole world. The wisdom behind each of 72 procedures has been refined from generation to generation. The times may change, some techniques may change, but what remains the same is the burning flame of the kiln that keeps setting so many hearts on fire for this ancient craft.

programme.title: The Elegance of Luoyang
programme.desc: Luoyang, as the eastern starting point of the Silk Road, is a city with a rich history and a tradition of cultural inclusivity. As such, it enjoys a prominent position in the heritage of the whole world. In this episode, we’ll visit White Horse Temple to learn about its fascinating international background. At Longmen Grottoes, which were designated as a UNESCO World Heritage Site in the year 2000, we’ll appreciate how the unique ancient splendor is being revived by 3D technology. At the city’s annual Peony Festival, we’ll explore the significance of China’s national flower and national dress. Invited to a Luoyang Water Banquet, we’ll learn something about the city’s culinary traditions. And finally, a master of tang sancai, or tri-color pottery, will discuss the legacy of this ancient craft and its place in the modern era.

programme.title: Foodwise: Huangshan Ep.2
programme.desc: In Huangshan, Anhui Province, the hosts enjoy a cup of Queen Elizabeth II's favorite tea, as well as the oldest green tea to be exported Europe, and get hands on with quirky local delicacies ranging from "word candy" and tofu made of leaves, to the downright funky flavors of hairy tofu and stinky mandarin fish.

programme.title: Foodwise: Fuding
programme.desc: The hosts are in Fuding, Fujian Province in southeast China for the Dragon Boat Festival, where teams of rowers compete against each other in narrow dragon-shaped boats. From making and eating zongzi rice dumplings to trying local street food, the hosts take part in the festivities before exploring the world of white tea, from visiting its “mother tree” to drinking it in a zen temple, and even feasting on a white tea banquet!

programme.title: Foodwise: Wuyi Mountains
programme.desc: The hosts are in the Wuyi Mountains of Fujian Province, the birthplace of oolong tea. Here they enjoy tea ceremony on a bamboo raft, feast on everything from smoked goose to lotus seed soup, and explore an ancient town that once sold tea to Russia. They discover that here it’s all about terroir, and that nestled within the cliffs of the Wuyi Mountains is the most expensive tea in the world.

programme.title: 2026 Spring Festival Gala Promo
programme.desc: China Media Group (CMG), the country's flagship broadcaster, has released a short video promoting its annual Spring Festival Gala, which will be broadcast live around the world on the evening of February 16.

programme.title: Foodwise: Hangzhou Ep.1
programme.desc: In this episode Tianran and Hannah are in Hangzhou, a city with over 2000 years of history and capital of two ancient Chinese dynasties. From the famous West Lake to delicate Dragon Well tea, our hosts experience Hangzhou's must-do attractions, savouring the local cuisine and trying everything from winter melon shaped like pork belly, to food cooked according to Traditional Chinese Medicine principles, and even Buddhist noodles and Zen tea.

programme.title: Foodwise: Hangzhou Ep.2
programme.desc: In this episode, Tianran and Hannah continue their tea-tasting journey along Hangzhou's Qiantang River, exploring the region's historical culture and culinary delights. They head to Anding Mountain, enjoying misty tea at the summit. In Longmen Ancient Town, they dive into traditional Chinese clan culture and savor “Sun Quan seitan”. In the gentrified village of Shishe, Hannah falls in love with “gray soup rice dumplings”, while at Qiandao Lake Tianran tries the best fish head and beluga caviar he’s ever had in his life. Their journey ends with a cup of Jiukeng tea and a visit to ancient tea trees.

programme.title: Aerial China III Ep.9
programme.desc: Hebei is, in a sense, a sort of geographic compendium of the whole of China. With the Yan Mountains demarcate plateaus from plains, they also stand guard over the strategic corridor linking the northeast to the country's heartland.

programme.title: Back to the Land: Exploring new life in rural China
programme.sub-title: Back to the Land: Exploring new life in rural China
programme.desc: When we think of the countryside, what colour comes to mind? The answer lies in Wuxin—Wood, Fire, Earth, Metal and Water—an ancient rhythm that still pulses beneath China’s landscapes. In this programme, we explore how the colours of Wuxing come to life through the traditions of China’s ethnic minority groups. From Lugu Lake’s matrilineal water world and the metal-hued fire of the Yi Torch Festival, to Dali’s earth-driven crafts, Guizhou’s wooden Dong dwellings, and the volcanic winds of Inner Mongolia’s new nomadic life—the Five Elements guide the stories of people reconnecting with land, culture and community.

programme.title: Quanzhou Nanyin: A Living Fossil in the History of Chinese Music
programme.sub-title: Quanzhou Nanyin: A Living Fossil in the History of Chinese Music
programme.desc: Nanyin, also known as “Quanzhou Nanyin,” is an ancient Han Chinese musical tradition whose singing style preserves the time-honored ethnic vocal techniques predating the Tang Dynasty, earning it the title of “a living fossil in the history of Chinese music.” The program features Yegor, a Ukrainian music enthusiast, visiting Master Su Shuyong, a Nanyin inheritor, to hear her decades-long stories of teaching this art. They also tour the Quanzhou Nanyin Troupe, where, led by its artistic director Zhuang Lifen, they learn about the basic performance formats and instruments of Nanyin. Additionally, the episode follows a post-1990s Nanyin performer, Zheng Mingming, as she sips tea with guests at sunset, reflecting on the deep-rooted role Nanyin plays in the daily lives of Quanzhou’s people.

The times may change, some techniques may change, but what remains the same is the burning flame of the kiln that keeps setting so many hearts on fire for this ancient craft.

programme.title: The Elegance of Luoyang
programme.desc: Luoyang, as the eastern starting point of the Silk Road, is a city with a rich history and a tradition of cultural inclusivity. As such, it enjoys a prominent position in the heritage of the whole world. In this episode, we’ll visit White Horse Temple to learn about its fascinating international background. At Longmen Grottoes, which were designated as a UNESCO World Heritage Site in the year 2000, we’ll appreciate how the unique ancient splendor is being revived by 3D technology. At the city’s annual Peony Festival, we’ll explore the significance of China’s national flower and national dress. Invited to a Luoyang Water Banquet, we’ll learn something about the city’s culinary traditions. And finally, a master of tang sancai, or tri-color pottery, will discuss the legacy of this ancient craft and its place in the modern era.

programme.title: Foodwise: Shantou
programme.desc: Tianran and Hannah are in Shantou, Guangdong Province in south China, where they drink more tea than anywhere else in the country. They'll savor the complex aroma of the curiously named "Duck Poo Fragrance" tea, as well as enjoy a more traditional "yum cha" breakfast. They get a taste of traditional handicrafts, from breaking bowls to make inlaid porcelain to rolling "kueh" rice cakes, and feast on everything from sweet and savory street snacks to the finest seafood dining.

programme.title: Foodwise: Shaoguan
programme.desc: Tianran and Hannah are in the picturesque city of Shaoguan in Guangdong Province, South China. They try tea grown on Danxia landforms and feast on mountain produce, before getting hands-on with making rice noodles in a Hakka walled village. They learn about the Hakka people’s southward migration and the effect it had on local tea and food, and end their journey in a thousand-year-old Buddhist temple, seeing how the monks integrate their practice into everyday life, and discovering just why tea is so important to Zen.

This episode will be released as a 30 minute travel documentary to be broadcast on CGTN's television channel and social media platform, along with a series of video clips and photos

programme.title: Thrill Seeker’s Guide to China: Mount Siguniang
programme.sub-title: Thrill Seeker’s Guide to China: Mount Siguniang
programme.desc: In this episode, Host Tianran He is on a mission: To reach the summit of Mount Siguniang, a towering snowcapped mountain in southwestern China. Together with his friend Ma Chunlin, a photographer for National Geographic, they trek through one of China’s most beautiful and biodiverse hiking routes, before making for base camp. But with worsening weather conditions and severe altitude sickness, the odds are stacked against them. Ten years ago, Tianran failed his attempt at climbing Mount Siguniang’s First Peak – this time, he’s all in.

programme.title: Thrill Seeker’s Guide to China: Changbai Mountain
programme.sub-title: Thrill Seeker’s Guide to China: Changbai Mountain
programme.desc: An unforgettable adventure awaits amidst the breathtaking landscapes of Changbai Mountain! Embark on a trek through pristine birch forests, marvel at the majestic power of the world's deepest volcanic waterfall, and uncover hidden gems along the way. Indulge in soaking in natural hot springs and experience exhilarating rafting down mountain streams, all leading to the final destination: Tianchi Lake, a heavenly oasis nestled in the clouds. Join the Travelogue team as we delve into the beauty of Changbai Mountain.

programme.title: Aerial China III Ep.10
programme.desc: Where Ningxia's desert frontiers give way to the Yellow River's 397km embrace, they carve out a distinctive landscape that is any but dry and arid. Come and see a land of oases where sand and dust give way to a terrain as lush and green as the lands south of the Yangtze!

programme.title: Taohuawu New Year's Painting
programme.desc: Taohuawu New Year woodblock prints, originating from Suzhou, are iconic symbols of Chinese folk art. These vibrant prints, traditionally displayed during Chinese New Year, depict auspicious scenes, deities, and daily life, embodying wishes for prosperity and happiness. Explore the intricate carving and printing techniques that bring these colorful cultural treasures to life.

programme.title: Ding Porcelain Firing
programme.desc: In ancient times, skilled craftsmen combined clay with fire and, using nothing more than their hands and wisdom, created the history of porcelain. A thousand years ago, at the time of the Northern Song Dynasty, a type of porcelain was produced that stood out for its exquisite quality, elegant coloring and beautiful patterns. This was Ding porcelain, and it became a favorite at the imperial court. However, within 200 years, amid the chaos of constant warfare, the art of making it was lost. The dazzling white light of the Ding kilns had faded, seemingly forever. And yet, 800 years later, that light has been reignited.

programme.title: 2026 Spring Festival Gala Promo
programme.desc: China Media Group (CMG), the country's flagship broadcaster, has released a short video promoting its annual Spring Festival Gala, which will be broadcast live around the world on the evening of February 16.

programme.title: From Stone to Story
programme.desc: China's profound stone carving culture dates back to the Han Dynasty (202 BC – 220 AD) and flourished during the Tang Dynasty (618 – 907 AD), evolving into a distinctive art form and unique cultural practice. Among many places famous for stone carving, Hui’an County—through generations of dedicated artisans—has risen to prominence and earned the esteemed title of "World Capital of Stone Carving," awarded by the World Crafts Council. The county’s skilled stonemasons are celebrated for their ability to transform ordinary pieces of rock into beautiful works of art. This episode shines a spotlight on the intangible cultural heritage of Hui’an stone carving and reveals how it has been influenced by the area’s close proximity to the sea.

programme.title: World Heritage in China: Ancient City of Pingyao
programme.sub-title: World Heritage in China: Ancient City of Pingyao
programme.desc: Established in the 14th century, Pingyao retains the typical layout of the county-level cities of the Han people in Central China. The ancient city is a complete community comprising walls, streets and lanes, shops, houses and temples.?As a UNESCO World Heritage site, Pingyao remains a testament to traditional Chinese urban planning and architecture, attracting visitors from around the world who seek to explore its historical streets and vibrant history.

programme.desc: Stay updated with all key headlines, major developments, top trending stories, and one focused Special 20 segment offering quick, detailed coverage.

programme.title: Food Unknown S1 - "Philippines"
programme.desc: De eilandstaat met 7.000 eilanden heeft geen gebrek aan strand, zon of zee – maar kampt met een hardnekkig imagoprobleem als het om de keuken gaat. Jonathan landt in Manila en ontdekt al snel dat de topchefs zich maar al te goed bewust zijn van dit probleem. Op hun advies vertrekt hij op expeditie om een deel van de oplossing te vinden. De reis voert hem van dorpen van voormalige koppensnellers, via koloniale stadjes waar de tijd heeft stilgestaan, tot restaurants in de schaduw van het Amerikaanse militaire machtsblok. Gaandeweg ontvouwt zich een intrigerend verhaal. In de dichte jungle blijft het ene geheim begraven, terwijl het andere letterlijk uit het houtwerk tevoorschijn komt. Maar het gevaar is nooit ver weg… zombie-achtige murenen, aardverschuivingsgevoelige bergpassen en verboden velden achter de rijstvelden.

programme.title: Food Unknown S1 - "Finland"
programme.desc: Finland is dat ene Noordse land dat zelden op de wereldkaart van de gastronomie verschijnt. Maar terwijl niemand keek, hebben de terughoudende Finnen stilletjes hun wildplukcultuur verfijnd en verweven in een unieke keuken. Jonathan Legg doorkruist het hele land om de Finse gastronomie te doorgronden – en de filosofie van de beste chefs te begrijpen. Van verbluffende gerechten met lokale ingrediënten in Helsinki tot een expeditie in Lapland om alles te leren over wildplukken en de Finse delicatesse: rendier!

programme.title: Food Unknown S1 - "Ireland"
programme.desc: Het is de geboorteplaats van Halloween, maar de geesten en griezels die de wereld hebben doorkruist, hebben weinig belangstelling gewekt voor de Ierse keuken. Jonathan stapt op een klassieke motor en doorkruist een land vol mystieke tradities, uitbundige locals en iconische landschappen. ’s Werelds meest onweerstaanbare pubcultuur trekt hem aan, grensconflicten drijven hem weg en duistere legendes lokken hem verder. Een avontuur doordrenkt van regen, sagen en het eten van voorouders uit vervlogen tijden.

programme.title: Epic Exploring S2 - "Ruhr District"
programme.desc: Josh verkent het industriële Rurhgebied in Duitsland en ontdekt verlaten staal- en mijnfabrieken en ervaart het leven van de mijnwerker onder de grond.

programme.title: Travel Quest S1 - "Brazil…The Amazon"
programme.desc: Een jaguar in het wild zien is vrijwel onmogelijk, maar samen met een van de vooraanstaande jaguarexperts neemt Bill deel aan een prooi-roofdierstudie om zijn kansen te vergroten. Tijdens het onderzoek komt hij letterlijk oog in oog te staan met een 5,5 meter lange Amazone-anaconda.

programme.title: Travel Quest S1 - "Antarctica"
programme.desc: Woeste oceanen, gigantische ijsbergen en adembenemende landschappen zijn dagelijkse kost op het Zuidelijk Continent. Bill loopt mee met onderzoekers die tellingen uitvoeren van een van de meest fascinerende vogels ter wereld: de pinguïn.

programme.title: Travel Quest S1 - "Papua New Guinea"
programme.desc: Er is geen plek op aarde met zo’n rijke culturele diversiteit als Papoea-Nieuw-Guinea. Bill volgt het spoor van de legendarische koppensnellers diep het regenwoud in en ontdekt geheimen die nog mysterieuzer zijn.

programme.title: Beyond The Beaten Path S1 - "Donsol, Philippines"
programme.desc: Rampen en triomfen maken deze reis onvergetelijk. De broers beginnen met een bijna-dodelijk bootongeluk in de zuidelijke Filippijnse Zee, maar weten zich te herstellen en bereiken uiteindelijk hun doel: het dorp Donsol, de walhaai-hoofdstad van de wereld.

programme.title: Beyond The Beaten Path S1 - "Ryozenji Temple Shikoku, Japan"
programme.desc: In deze aflevering vermijden de broers de bekendere plekken zoals Tokyo en Kyoto en trekken ze naar het afgelegen, eeuwenoude eiland Shikoku. Hun route volgt de historische 88 Tempel Zen-pelgrimstocht.

programme.title: Beyond The Beaten Path S1 - "Cape Breton Island, Canada"
programme.desc: Per pick-uptruck verkennen de broers het cultureel en geografisch rijke eiland Cape Breton en de beroemde Cabot Trail. Hummervissen, vishaken, elks spotten, bingo, Schotse ceilidhs, Mi'kmaq-trommelsessies – alles komt voorbij in deze aflevering.

programme.title: Epic Trails S3 - "Backpacking Québec – Part 1"
programme.desc: Eric Hanson verkent de epische kustwandelroutes van Gaspésie en beleeft ongelooflijke nachtwandelingen in de wildernis van de Eastern Townships in Québec.

programme.title: Epic Trails S3 - "Backpacking Québec – Part 2"
programme.desc: Eric Hanson maakt een trektocht langs het spectaculaire Saguenayfjord, voordat hij aan een peddelavontuur in de Laurentian Mountains van Québec begint.

programme.title: Epic Trails S3 - "Backpacking Québec – Part 3"
programme.desc: Eric Hanson trotseert de elementen tijdens een vroege sneeuwstorm in Charlevoix en jaagt daarna zijn adrenaline op met een wildwatertocht op de machtige Ottawa-rivier.

programme.title: Kindness Diaries S2 - "The Gift of Friendship"
programme.desc: Na aankomst in Argentinië verblijft Leon bij een dakloze familie. Hij gaat bungeejumpen en ontmoet een Haïtiaanse student met een gouden hart.

programme.title: Kindness Diaries S2 - "The Gift of Kindness"
programme.desc: Leon rijdt naar 'De bodem van de wereld'. Hij herinnert zich iedereen die hem onderweg heeft geholpen, en zal nog één bijzonder geschenk uitdelen...

programme.title: Epic Exploring S2 - "Isle of Wight"
programme.desc: Cody ervaart het 'eilandleven' op het Eiland Wight in Engeland, de ware hemel voor urban exploring, compleet met eeuwenoude vuurtoren en een verlaten vakantieresort.

programme.title: Epic Exploring S2 - "Charleroi"
programme.desc: Een verkenningstocht in het industriële Charleroi brengt Cody naar verlaten fabrieken en een onbekende plek vol kleurrijke graffiti. Een oud casino wordt ontdekt.

programme.title: Epic Exploring S2 - "Nicosia"
programme.desc: Josh is in Cyprus voor een lokaal verkenningsavontuur op het eiland en gaat op roadtrip van Nicosia naar een verlaten attractiepark, een asbestmijn en een scheepswrak.

programme.title: Travel Quest S1 - "South Korea"
programme.desc: Volg Bill terwijl hij een immens middeleeuws fort bezoekt dat doet denken aan de Verboden Stad. Van reusachtige grafheuvels en nieuwe olympische locaties tot bewegend voedsel – Bill gaat op zoek naar de ziel van dit moderne, eeuwenoude land.

programme.title: Travel Quest S1 - "Yap"
programme.desc: De meest waanzinnige duik beleeft hij echter wanneer hij tientallen haaien voert – zonder enige bescherming. In een poging dat op land te overtreffen, sluit Bill een ongelooflijke deal met een lokale stamhoofd om te filmen op een plek waar nog nooit eerder is gefilmd… Het Verboden Eiland.

programme.title: Travel Quest S1 - "Madagascar"
programme.desc: Het echte Madagaskar kent geen pratende leeuwen, zebra’s of nijlpaarden. Wat het wél heeft, is de meest unieke verzameling planten en dieren op aarde. Bill trotseert het nauwelijks toegankelijke terrein om een zeldzame dansende lemuur te vinden – en een andere die zingt.

programme.title: Beyond The Beaten Path S1 - "Volcan Madera, Nicaragua"
programme.desc: De broers bereiken hun doel door op motorfietsen naar het hart van Nicaragua te rijden. Ze doorkruisen de jungle naar afgelegen stranden aan de Pacifische kust en reizen landinwaarts door Spaanse koloniale steden, lokale dorpen en het immense vulkanische eiland Ometepe.

programme.title: Beyond The Beaten Path S1 - "Yorkshire Dales, England"
programme.desc: Stel je een kroegentocht voor langs 26 pubs, verspreid over 7 dagen en 60 mijl! Tijdens een traditionele ramble door de adembenemende Yorkshire Dales in Noord-Engeland trekken de broers door heidevelden, dalen, pieken en valleien – met benen én lever nog intact.

programme.title: Beyond The Beaten Path S1 - "Erg Chigagga, Sahara, Morocco"
programme.desc: Vanuit Marrakesh nemen de broers een reeks lokale Berber-taxi’s over het High Atlasgebergte en dalen af in de Draa-vallei, totdat de weg eindigt aan de rand van de eindeloze zandzee van de Sahara, waar ze een verborgen schat begraven.

programme.title: Epic Trails S3 - "New Zealand"
programme.desc: Eric Hanson verkent de prachtige wandelroutes rond Mount Taranaki en Mount Hikurangi op het Noordereiland van Nieuw-Zeeland.

programme.title: The Armchair Adventurer S1 - "The Valley of Desolation"
programme.desc: Xander en z'n team bezoeken Graaff-Reinet, één van de oudste steden in Zuid-Afrika, om de cuisine, geschiedenis en natuur te ervaren. Adam verdoet zijn tijd met het zoeken naar fossielen.

programme.title: The Armchair Adventurer S1 - "The Dullstroom Highlands"
programme.desc: Xander en zijn team rijden elf uur lang naar Dullstroom, een pittoresk stadje waar vissen en drank de boventoon voert. Door een beetje mee te kunnen doen, vindt Adam iets interessants in de supermarkt.

programme.title: The Armchair Adventurer S1 - "The Panorama"
programme.desc: Aan weerszijden van de wereld proberen Adam en een lid van de Zuid-Afrikaanse crew hun angsten te overwinnen.

programme.title: Kindness Diaries S1 - "The Gift of Love"
programme.desc: Met een gratis tank vol benzine, gegeven door een reiziger, verlaten Leon en zijn motorfiets Kindness One® de stad LA. In Sin City spelen ze letterlijk met hun geluk, voordat ze hulp vinden van een Schot in een afgelegen Westernstadje in Colorado. Deze ontmoeting inspireert hem voor zijn eerste verrassingsgeschenk.

programme.title: Kindness Diaries S1 - "The Gift of Security"
programme.desc: Leon ervaart het boerenleven op een veeboerderij in Nebraska. Hij heeft motorproblemen in Chicago, en wordt genegeerd door de Amish. Maar een toevallige ontmoeting met een dakloze man in Pittsburgh werkt inspirerend, en helpt hem om zijn volgende geschenk te vinden.

programme.title: Kindness Diaries S1 - "The Gift of Inspiration"
programme.desc: Leon vindt onderdak in de gevaarlijkste stad ter wereld, en baant zich een weg over de Atlantische Oceaan aan boord van een vrachtschip. Een Spaanse douaneprobleem dreigt zijn reis te doen ontsporen, maar de muziek van twee Afrikaanse muzikanten in Zuid-Frankrijk inspireren zijn volgende geschenk.

programme.title: Travel Quest S1 - "Mongolia"
programme.desc: Niets op aarde is te vergelijken met Mongolië. Hier trekken de laatste nomadische volkeren met hun vee over miljoenen hectaren grasland. Bill drinkt gefermenteerde merriemelk (volgens hem het smerigste drankje ooit), rijdt op een jak en spoort het oorspronkelijke wilde paard op.

programme.title: Travel Quest S1 - "North Pole"
programme.desc: Het team vaart met een ijsbreker naar de Noordpool, net op tijd om Bill’s moeder via een satelliettelefoon te bellen en haar een gelukkige verjaardag te wensen (ze is zo verbaasd dat ze hem niet herkent). Ondertussen volgen en filmen ze de grootste roofdieren op aarde… ijsberen.

programme.title: Travel Quest S1 - "Rwanda…Gorillas"
programme.desc: Bill trekt door eindeloze modder, dichte vegetatie en steile bergen om oog in oog te staan met onze machtige verwanten – de gorilla’s. Hij volgt ook het leven en ontdekt de restanten van het kamp van een van zijn helden: Dian Fossey.

programme.title: Beyond The Beaten Path S1 - "Arviat, Nunavut, Canada"
programme.desc: Op weg naar het uiterste noorden, naar de Arctis, om de traditionele cultuur en het indrukwekkende leven van de Inuit te ontdekken, vergezellen de broers een oudere en een jonge jager op een 200 mijl lange sneeuwscootertocht over het barre land en bevroren zee-ijs.

programme.title: Epic Trails S1 - "Banff & Lake Louise"
programme.desc: Eric Hanson gaat heli-hiken en verkent grotten terwijl hij Canada’s eerste en meest populaire nationale park en het naburige Lake Louise ontdekt.

programme.title: Epic Trails S1 - "Australia’s Northern Territory"
programme.desc: Eric Hanson reist naar Australië om de Larapinta Trail en het Kakadu National Park te verkennen.

programme.title: The Armchair Adventurer S1 - "Into the Bush"
programme.desc: Terwijl Xander en zijn crew de bush intrekken, ontdekken ze de mooiste aspecten van Zuid-Afrika: nationale parken, safari's en wilde dieren.

programme.title: The Armchair Adventurer S1 - "The Lowveldt"
programme.desc: Terwijl Adam vecht tegen een golf van droefenis, beleven Xander en zijn team een Afrikaanse safari te paard, waarbij ze spectaculaire wilde dieren en adembenemende savannes bewonderen.

programme.title: Kindness Diaries S1 - "The Gift of Transformation"
programme.desc: Nadat hij in St. Tropez is verdwaald op het Italiaanse platteland, vindt Leon onderdak in een 18e-eeuwse villa buiten Turijn. Maar zijn geluk raakt op aan de oevers van het Comomeer.

programme.title: Kindness Diaries S1 - "The Gift of Abundance"
programme.desc: Na gesurft te hebben in Zagreb, en nadat Leon de turbulente geschiedenis van Sarajevo heeft leren kennen, gaan hij op de Kindness One® naar Montenegro. Daar ontmoet hij een vriendelijke boer, wiens familie al 20 generaties lang hetzelfde land bewerkt. Dit inspireert hem tot zijn volgende verrassingscadeau.

programme.title: Travel Quest S1 - "Botswana"
programme.desc: Botswana is een droom voor natuurliefhebbers, met enorme kuddes olifanten, reusachtige groepen nijlpaarden en enkele van de grootste leeuwentroepen ter wereld. Het is ook de thuisbasis van de Victoriawatervallen – de grootste waterval ter wereld.

programme.title: Travel Quest S1 - "Botswana"
programme.desc: Botswana is een droom voor natuurliefhebbers, met enorme kuddes olifanten, reusachtige groepen nijlpaarden en enkele van de grootste leeuwentroepen ter wereld. Het is ook de thuisbasis van de Victoriawatervallen – de grootste waterval ter wereld.

programme.title: Travel Quest S1 - "New Zealand & Australia"
programme.desc: Bill is altijd al gefascineerd geweest door de America's Cup-zeilrace – en die is net zo intens als de naam doet vermoeden. Maar het echte avontuur beleeft hij in een Sovjet Mig-jet: hij vliegt mee, voert stunts uit en maakt zenuwslopende laagvliegers mee.

programme.title: Travel Quest S1 - "New Zealand & Australia"
programme.desc: Bill is altijd al gefascineerd geweest door de America's Cup-zeilrace – en die is net zo intens als de naam doet vermoeden. Maar het echte avontuur beleeft hij in een Sovjet Mig-jet: hij vliegt mee, voert stunts uit en maakt zenuwslopende laagvliegers mee.

programme.title: Beyond The Beaten Path S1 - "Kushtia, Bangladesh"
programme.desc: De broers doorkruisen het onderling verbonden netwerk van waterwegen per veerboot. Van een garnalenbaron tot eenvoudige vissers, van eeuwenoude tempelruïnes tot anonieme chai wallahs – ze banen zich een weg naar Kushtia, de thuisbasis van het heiligdom van Guru Lalone Shaw.

programme.title: Beyond The Beaten Path S1 - "Kingdom of Mustang, Nepal"
programme.desc: Met speciale visa op zak regelen de broers 10 pony’s en 6 dragers en beginnen ze aan een adembenemende, maar zware 13-daagse ponytocht over de Himalaya naar de Mustang-vallei, waar ze hopen een ontmoeting met de koning te regelen.

programme.title: Epic Trails S1 - "Fiji"
programme.desc: Eric Hanson verlaat de gebaande paden en trekt van het ene afgelegen dorp naar het andere door het bergachtige landschap van Fiji.

programme.title: Epic Trails S1 - "New Zealand"
programme.desc: Eric Hanson verkent het wereldberoemde Abel Tasman National Park te voet en per zeekajak.

programme.title: Epic Trails S1 - "Peru"
programme.desc: Eric Hanson dompelt zich onder in de fascinerende cultuur van Peru en verkent de wandelroutes en eeuwenoude ruïnes van de Heilige Vallei.

programme.title: The Armchair Adventurer S1 - "From Ohrigstad to Pilgrims Rest"
programme.desc: Van de Echogrotten tot het historische Pilgrim's Rest, Xander begint zich weer thuis te voelen op de regio in Zuid-Afrika waar hij is opgegroeid.

programme.title: The Armchair Adventurer S1 - "Winelands of the Cape"
programme.desc: Terwijl Xander en zijn team genieten van heerlijke gerechten en wijn bij het wijnhuis Spier, brengt Adam zijn dag door met het maken van cider en doorzoeken van familiebezittingen.

programme.title: The Armchair Adventurer S1 - "From Grabouw to Botriver"
programme.desc: Een wijnboerderij omringd door bergen, een dag wandelen inclusief picknicken, en verrukkelijk eten in combinatie met eersteklas wijn staat op het programma voor Xander en zijn team op hun route van Grabouw naar Botrivier.

programme.title: Kindness Diaries S1 - "The Gift of Service"
programme.desc: In Kosovo ontmoet Leon een moslimvrouw die droomt van vrede. Wat motorproblemen in Griekenland openen de deur voor avontuur. De gastvrijheid op grote hoogte in Turkije inspireert hem tot het volgende verrassingscadeau.

programme.title: Kindness Diaries S1 - "The Gift of Tomorrow"
programme.desc: Leon ontvangt een eervolle zegen op zijn reis. In Efeze treedt Leon in de voetsporen van apostel Paulus, voordat de escalatie van een conflict in het Midden-Oosten zijn reis in gevaar brengen.

programme.title: Kindness Diaries S1 - "The Gift of Education"
programme.desc: Leon en Kindness One® bezoeken 's werelds beroemdste monument van de liefde, de Taj Mahal, voordat hun reis op een muur stuit - letterlijk. Na een dag hard werken op een Indiase boerderij reist Leon naar de Stad van Vuur.

programme.title: Travel Quest S1 - "Kenya's Great Grasslands"
programme.desc: Fietsen is doorgaans een veilige en ontspannen bezigheid – totdat je het doet in de wildernis van Kenia, tussen leeuwen, olifanten en buffels.

programme.title: Travel Quest S1 - "Wild Indonesia"
programme.desc: Bill had twee wilde iconen die hij per se wilde meemaken. De eerste: de grootste hagedis ter wereld – de Komodovaraan. Tussen deze reusachtige beesten lopen was op zijn zachtst gezegd zenuwslopend. De andere: de enige mensaap van Azië – de orang-oetan.

programme.title: Travel Quest S2 - "Cultural Indonesia"
programme.desc: Van alle bucketlist-ervaringen springt er één erbovenuit: het aanschouwen van een van de oorspronkelijke redenen voor de oprichting van de UNESCO-Werelderfgoedlijst – de indrukwekkende tempel van Borobudur.

programme.title: Beyond The Beaten Path S1 - "Iceberg Alley, Newfoundland, Canada"
programme.desc: In een bushplane vliegen de broers naar het uiterste punt van ‘The Rock’ en keren ze terug naar het ruige, afgelegen eiland waar ze zijn geboren. Per kajak peddelen ze van visserijhaven naar visserijhaven, totdat ze hun ultieme bestemming bereiken.

programme.title: The Great Wall with Ash Dykes S1 - "The First Wall"
programme.desc: Ash’ reis langs de Chinese Muur begint op het meest oostelijke punt, bij een eeuwenoud deel dat bekendstaat als de Chu-Muur. Daarna reist Ash naar de Shaolintempel in de stad Dengfeng om kennis te maken met hun eeuwenoude gebruiken.

programme.title: The Great Wall with Ash Dykes S1 - "Underwater"
programme.desc: Vanaf Old Dragon’s Head trekt Ash westwaarts, waar hij een Muurbeschermer ontmoet die zijn leven heeft gewijd aan het behoud van dit iconische bouwwerk. Daarna maakt hij zich op voor een onverwacht avontuur: duiken bij de onder water gelopen resten van de Chinese Muur.

programme.title: The Great Wall with Ash Dykes S1 - "Beijing and beyond"
programme.desc: Ash is aangekomen in Peking, waar hij Terry Townsend ontmoet om meer te leren over natuurbescherming in de regio rond de Chinese Muur. Ook ontmoet hij twee andere Muurbeschermers en proeft hij lokale lekkernijen in het dorp Shi Xia.

programme.title: Roads End S1 - "Re-live"
programme.desc: In deze aflevering herbeleven Rob en Dave enkele van de hoogtepunten van hun ongelofelijke reis van 6000 km.

programme.title: Epic Exploring S2 - "New Orleans"
programme.desc: Cody is samen met Lexi Limitless in de 'Big Easy' om New Orleans te verkennen en bezoekt een verlaten liefdadigheidsziekenhuis voordat hij Brutus, de gigantische alligator, ontmoet.

programme.title: Epic Exploring S2 - "Yerevan"
programme.desc: Josh verkent de buurt in Armenië en de hoofdstad Yerevan, bezoekt enkele verlaten Sovjet gebouwen, een breifabriek en een luxe hotel.

programme.title: Epic Exploring S2 - "Gary, Indiana"
programme.desc: Josh is terug in Gary, Indiana, voor een lokale verkenningstocht. Samen met vrienden bezoekt hij een voormalige bank, het gedenkauditorium en treinstation Union.

programme.title: Travel Quest S2 - "New South Wales, Australia"
programme.desc: Nieuw-Zuid-Wales is de thuisbasis van Sydney, met het iconische Opera House en Harbour Bridge. Bill probeert de gigantische stalen constructie te beklimmen om de stad van bovenaf te bewonderen.

programme.title: Travel Quest S2 - "Siberia & Mongolia"
programme.desc: In deze aflevering reis je letterlijk naar enkele van de meest afgelegen plekken ter wereld. Eerst een bezoek aan Siberië… een van de meest onherbergzame gebieden op aarde – al blijken veel van de angstaanjagende verhalen grotendeels mythen te zijn.

programme.title: Travel Quest S2 - "Philippines"
programme.desc: De Filippijnen zijn een ongelooflijke bestemming met talloze herinneringen aan de Tweede Wereldoorlog, historische connecties die teruggaan tot Magellan en een gelukkige, vriendelijke bevolking.

programme.title: Beyond The Beaten Path S1 - "Lake Titicaca, Peru"
programme.desc: De broers liften vanuit de oude Inca-hoofdstad Cuzco langs de ruggengraat van de Andes naar het Titicacameer. Ze krijgen te maken met ernstige hoogteziekte, kauwen op cocabladeren om op krachten te blijven en ontmoeten lokale bewoners terwijl ze zich een weg banen door het Andesgebergte.

programme.title: Beyond The Beaten Path S1 - "Luxor, Egypt"
programme.desc: Voor hun reis door Egypte kiezen de broers een felucca, een eeuwenoud handelsvaartuig. Ze varen noordwaarts over de Nijl, van de oasestad Aswan naar de oude stad Luxor, voordat ze een gigantische zandduin ontdekken waar ze vanaf glijden.

programme.title: Beyond The Beaten Path S1 - "Abisko, Swedish Lapland"
programme.desc: Lapland is een bevroren winterland vol rendieren, Sami-tradities en sauna’s. De broers beginnen in Stockholm en vliegen 200 kilometer recht naar het noorden, boven de poolcirkel. Hun vervoermiddel voor deze reis: een rendierslee.

programme.title: Epic Trails S1 - "Winter in Banff & Lake Louise"
programme.desc: Eric Hanson keert terug naar Banff National Park en Lake Louise in de wintermaanden om het ongerepte achterland te verkennen met sneeuwschoenen en een snowboard.

programme.title: Epic Trails S1 - "The Jordan Trail"
programme.desc: Eric Hanson reist naar Jordanië om de nieuw ontwikkelde ‘Jordan Trail’ te bewandelen – een 450 mijl lange route die het hele land doorkruist en langs enkele van ’s werelds meest inspirerende landschappen en historische locaties voert, waaronder de oude stad Petra.

programme.title: Epic Trails S2 - "Papua New Guinea"
programme.desc: Eric Hanson bezoekt wilde en afgelegen dorpen in Papoea-Nieuw-Guinea en daagt zichzelf uit op een van de zwaarste paden ter wereld, de Kokoda Track.

programme.title: Roads End S1 - "Their Adventure Begins"
programme.desc: Twee adrenalinkejunks die niets liever willen dan een off-road avontuur op de motor. En ze gaan hun meest epische reis ooit tegemoet, naar Argentinië.

programme.title: Roads End S1 - "Broken Bike"
programme.desc: Rob en Dave verleggen hun grenzen. Ze vechten zich een ruige weg door zinderende zandduinen , waarbij de begroeiing ervoor zorgt dat Rob niet door kan gaan.

programme.title: Roads End S1 - "Separate Riders"
programme.desc: Het geduld van Rob en Dave wordt op de proef gesteld en de gehele trip is afhankelijk van de gebroken koppeling van Rob. Moeten ze een nieuwe motor kopen?

programme.title: Epic Exploring S2 - "Zagreb"
programme.desc: In Epic Exploring: Going Local wordt Zagreb, Kroatië bezocht. Cody vuurt een kanon af in de oude toren, verkent een nooit afgebouwd universiteitsziekenhuis en een politiekschool.

programme.title: Kindness Diaries S1 - "The Gift of Joy"

programme.desc: While all life began in the oceans, human beings now rely on technology to navigate the seven seas – left to our own devices; we’re like the proverbial fish out of water. Only the other way around.

programme.title: Super Senses S1 - "Sky"
programme.desc: Animals that live life on the wing, have a vast expanse of sky to navigate, find mates, locate food, and avoid predators in… Living in this aerial realm requires a unique set of senses, specialized to cope with life above ground…

programme.title: Wild Ones S1 - "FASTEST"
programme.desc: Wild Ones draws inspiration from the rhythms of nature, delving into the wonders of the animal kingdom. This captivating series explores the diverse behaviors that define survival—hunting and feeding strategies, family bonds, defense tactics, and the intricacies of courtship and mating. Who reigns supreme in the wild? Discover the untold stories of nature's fiercest competitors and most fascinating creatures.

programme.title: Wild Ones S1 - "DANGEROUS ON LAND"
programme.desc: Wild Ones draws inspiration from the rhythms of nature, delving into the wonders of the animal kingdom. This captivating series explores the diverse behaviors that define survival—hunting and feeding strategies, family bonds, defense tactics, and the intricacies of courtship and mating. Who reigns supreme in the wild? Discover the untold stories of nature's fiercest competitors and most fascinating creatures.

programme.title: Wild Ones S1 - "CUTEST"
